name: general stuff plus games
details:
### New Features
- Added the new Terminal Command Deck layout.
- Integrated new navigation, search, clock, widgets, and taskbar elements.

### Game Library
- Removed all Roblox-related games from the catalog.
- Expanded game-card dimensions for larger artwork.
- Improved game-card action icon spacing.
- Continued improvements to game catalog loading and reliability.

### SGS Cinema
- Improved movie player opening behavior.
- Added a dedicated video display viewport.
- Improved player window controls.
- Worked on popup prevention and proxy integration.

### Accounts & Login
- Reworked sign-in and account-creation behavior.
- Improved session verification and persistence.
- Fixed account panel and username display issues.
- Improved sign-out handling.

### Removed Features
- Completely removed the Wallpapers feature.
- Removed wallpaper selection, generation, and restoration functionality.
